decisions.statement: A cycle belongs to the whole folder and to no single file.
A file outside the change is read where the change reaches that file by import.
Only a cycle with a file the change has is refused.
A cycle the change closes has an import that change adds.
A change adding no import is judged without any file being read around it.
An added import is searched forward for the file that import is written in.
A cycle already there when the change arrived is the audit's rather than this.
An import the compiler erases is no edge.
A list of names is type-only when every name in the list is.
An import binding no name is an edge.
Only a top-level import or export is read.
Every file in a cycle is refused by its own path.
A specifier landing on no file the folder has is passed over.
A specifier inside akasha has its extension.
A loop closed through a deferred import alone is not refused though the code still loops.

definition: the check refusing a module under akasha that imports its way back around to itself
